hints.title: Pick a center
hints.body: Every palindrome has a center. An odd-length palindrome shares one central character, while an even-length palindrome has a gap between two central characters.

hints.title: Expand outward
hints.body: Starting from a center, move one character left and one character right. As long as both characters match, the enclosed section is another palindrome.

hints.title: Count both center types
hints.body: For each index, expand around the character itself and around the gap to its right. Together those two expansions cover every non-empty palindromic slice exactly once.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
total = 0
for center from 0 to length(text) - 1:
    total += expand(center, center)
    total += expand(center, center + 1)

expand(left, right):
    count = 0
    while left >= 0 and right < length(text) and text[left] == text[right]:
        count += 1
        left -= 1
        right += 1
    return count
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
